dossier.headline: #1 NYT Best Selling Author of The Let Them Theory
dossier.about: Mel Robbins is the creator and host of the award-winning The Mel Robbins Podcast, one of the most successful podcasts in the world, and a #1 New York Times bestselling author of The Let Them Theory. She's also the founder and CEO of the media production company 143 Studios. She has amassed 40 million followers online and is one of the most respected experts in mindset, life improvement, and behavior change. The Wall Street Journal calls her a “billion-view podcaster” and TIME Magazine says she gives millions of listeners around the globe “a reason to believe in themselves.” Her books have been translated into 63 languages and include the #1 New York Times, #1 Amazon, #1 Audible, and #1 Sunday Times bestselling The Let Them Theory, which is the top selling book of 2025 according to Publisher’s Weekly, with 7 million copies sold within nine months of its release date. It is on pace to have the best non-fiction book launch of all time. She is also the author of the multimillion-copy-selling The 5 Second Rule, The High 5 Habit, and seven #1 audiobook releases on Audible. USA Today calls Mel “a force to be reckoned with.” She is a global phenomenon in the publishing industry and podcasting. Her Boston-based media production company, 143 Studios, produces award-winning content, podcasts, events, audio series, online courses, journals, and books, along with professional development education forpartners likeStarbucks, Ulta Beauty, JP Morgan Chase, LinkedIn, Headspace, and Audible. The Mel Robbins Podcast has won some of the most prestigious awards given to podcasts, including Webby, Signal Awards, and iHeart. It was also recognized as one of Apple Podcasts' Top Shared and Followed Shows of 2024 and 2023 and Spotify Top Global Shows of 2024. Notable accolades for Robbins include being named to Time 100 Most Influential Digital Voices of 2025, a Forbes 50 Over 50 Honoree, USA Today Top 5 Mindset & Performance Coaches in the World, and one of the fifty most influential influencers on The Hollywood Reporter’s Creator A-List in 2024. Thanks for being here! Learn more at melrobbins.com. Reach my team: Press inquiries: TeamMelRobbins@align-pr.com Speaking inquiries: darrin@powellspeakers.com Brand partnership inquiries: MelRobbinsTeam@unitedtalent.com

Hey 👋 I’m Mel Host @themelrobbinspodcast Author @letthemtheory, #1 sold book of 2025 Co-founder @puregeniusprotein

I can’t believe I’m sitting down with someone I’ve looked up to for more than four decades: THE Oprah Winfrey. I first started watching @oprah on local television as a little girl in Michigan. Through every chapter of my life, I have returned to Oprah’s work for inspiration, encouragement, and direction. This is more than an interview for me. It is deeply personal. Now you get to hear the questions I’ve wanted to ask Oprah for years. Comment “Oprah” and I’ll send you a link to the episode. 🎧 “Oprah Winfrey: How to Find Your Unique Purpose, Authentic Power, and Calling In Life”

When @gabormatemd told me this, it stopped me in my tracks… Siblings may grow up in the same house, but that doesn’t mean their childhoods were the same. Not even close. Same parents? Nope. Same family? Nope. Same childhood? Absolutely not. Parents show up differently for each child depending on the season of their life, their relationship, and even their financial situation. It’s not about who is loved more. It’s about how that love is expressed — and how each child experiences it. If you’ve ever wondered why you and your siblings remember childhood so differently — this is why. This clip is from my conversation with Dr. Gabor Maté on @themelrobbinspodcast 🎧 “Why You Feel Lost in Life: Dr. Gabor Maté on Trauma & How to Heal.” You can learn more about this and so much more in his incredible book The Myth of Normal.

I’m gearing up for another incredible production week at our Boston studios. We have 8 incredible guests coming into the studio, which means I am about to be talking A LOT… so it’s time to make my usual run to CVS to stock up on all my production week essentials. Cough drops, hair bands, deodorant, Diet Coke. And now… @puregeniusprotein! @cvspharmacy now carries Pure Genius in single bottles, including our newest flavor, Pink Lemonade, which is exclusive to CVS and is currently my FAVORITE. Having Pure Genius Protein at CVS is so convenient for someone who regularly realizes she needs something five minutes before an interview. Head to the protein aisle at your local CVS and grab one to try. 💡

Breakups are painful because the future you thought you were going to have just died. Breakups are grief. On this episode of @themelrobbinspodcast, I’m answering YOUR questions including how to navigate a painful breakup. Comment “QUESTIONS” and I’ll DM you the link to the full episode. 🎧 “The Ultimate Life Advice: How to Get Motivated, Build Confidence & Create Better Relationships” Listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or YouTube - search “The Mel Robbins Podcast Questions”

“You can't learn from a mistake you're still defending.” In this episode of @themelrobbinspodcast, Dr. Dolly Chugh shares a mindset shift that completely changed how I think about growth, mistakes, and self-improvement. Comment “Dolly” and I’ll DM you the link to the full episode. Dr. @dolly.chugh is a renowned behavioral scientist, award-winning NYU Stern professor, and expert on why people resist change. She says, “instead of trying to prove yourself, you need to focus on improving yourself." Because you don’t grow by proving you were right. You grow by being open to doing better next time. 🎧 “Stop Wasting Your Energy: How to Deal With People Who Won’t Change & What to Do Instead” Listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or YouTube - search “Mel Robbins Podcast Dolly Chugh”

Staying together “for the kids” doesn’t automatically protect them. Comment “DIVORCE” and I’ll DM you the link to the full episode. World-renowned divorce attorney James Sexton (@nycdivorcelawyer) says your marriage teaches your children about love, conflict, and how two people should treat each other. On this episode of @themelrobbinspodcast, James explains why the real question isn’t just whether you stay married - it’s what kind of relationship you’re modeling for your children. 🎧 “What No One Tells You About Divorce (From #1 Divorce Lawyer)” Listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or YouTube - search “The Mel Robbins Podcast James Sexton”

Love isn’t always the grand gestures, the flowers or the perfect date nights. It’s who stands next to you when life falls apart…The person who helps you rebuild, not run away. If you’ve got someone like that in your corner, tag them in the comments and let them know how grateful you are for them ❤️

No matter what happens today, you can handle it. In this episode of @themelrobbinspodcast, I show you how to start your day right, with 8 simple sentences that reset your mindset and rewire your brain for the day ahead. Comment “Reset” and I’ll send you a link to the episode. 🎧 "8 Things To Tell Yourself Every Morning" Listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or YouTube - search "Mel Robbins Podcast 8 Things"

❤️ Family weddings Popcorn with friends Pulling tires on the beach w Adam Rehearsal dinners Martinis & Protein Beautiful Brides Beautiful flowers Best friends from college Muddy dogs Sunsets Love of My Life Home wooden bowls Dinner time Mr. Noodle Local eggs 💋

If something feels off, pay attention. Because your intuition notices things before your brain can explain them. So stop questioning yourself every time something doesn't feel right. Trust yourself. The more you listen to your intuition, the stronger it gets. ❤️

There’s a reason John Grisham is one of the greatest storytellers of our time. And what I love about @johngrisham is that so much of his success comes back to things I’m always reminding myself: show up, keep going, and trust the ideas you can’t stop thinking about. These are the lessons from John I’m taking with me. Which one will stay with you? Comment “JOHN” and I’ll DM you a link to the full episode. 🎧 “Feeling Stuck? The Simple Rule That Can Change Your Life” Listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or YouTube - search “Mel Robbins Podcast John Grisham”

One moment can change the direction of your entire life. @johngrisham, former attorney turned bestselling novelist, shares the courtroom experience that inspired him to write his first novel, A Time to Kill, even though he had never written fiction before. Comment "JOHN" and I'll DM you a link to the full episode. 🎧 “Feeling Stuck? The Simple Rule That Can Change Your Life” Listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or YouTube - search "Mel Robbins Podcast John Grisham"
